主要内容: LCS, a leading provider of senior lifestyle products and services, has expanded its real estate investment portfolio by acquiring Clarendale® at Indian Lake, a $48.5 million senior living community located in Hendersonville, Tennessee. This marks the fourth Clarendale senior living community for LCS and its partners, Ryan Companies and Harrison Street Real Estate Capital. The transaction was facilitated by LCS Real Estate, and the community will be managed by Life Care Services, both LCS companies. LCS holds equity positions in 39 senior living communities nationwide. David Laffey, Senior Vice President/Director of LCS Real Estate, highlighted the synergy with partners and the momentum gained from the real estate platform. LCS, based in Des Moines, Iowa, and established in 1971, offers a range of services including real estate private equity, insurance, and in-home care. LCS Real Estate provides capital market services, while Life Care Services manages operations and marketing for senior living communities.
